cmd:issue.note: :issue 12 or :issue #12 finds the Issue wherever it lives, archived included; bare :issue asks for the number

key:<Space>i.note: opens the Issues workspace for a project

module:ui/form_field.rs.note: the wrapped vim text field of every Issue editor and project form field (TUI #3421, desktop #317, hub #3439): each text field is a vim field through the one VimEditor (modes, counts, text objects, colon commands) with Vim keys on and plain editing with them off; it opens in INSERT with the caret at the end of its text; Esc in INSERT goes to NORMAL only, Esc in NORMAL on a dirty Issue form shows UNSAVED CHANGES and a further Esc discards; Tab / Shift-Tab move between fields; the mode shows in the field border and tag. A one-line field (title, labels, assignee, dependency number, filter and search inputs, project name and folder) is a textarea that wraps and grows with its text and never takes a newline (Enter submits); the Issue title is cut at 200 characters in the editor only, with a live counter from 150 and a hint when typing is refused or a paste cut. The description is multi-line and scrolls. Field order, validation, stale-conflict handling, the discard confirmation and submit are unchanged, and the mouse still works. Tests: tests/form-text.test.mjs, scripts/smoke-vim.mjs scenarios issue-editor-fields, issue-form-esc-contract, title-limit, project-form-fields, issue-filter-dependency-fields, form-fields-vim-off

module:ui/issue_detail.rs.note: the inspector with body, metadata, dependencies, events, handoffs and the associated-session selection (G2). The body and every handoff are rendered as Markdown with the transcript's renderer and sanitizer (headings, lists, emphasis, code, tables, links; a View raw button shows the text as written; links open in the system browser, never the webview; #293). Substitute for the fold cursor: handoffs fold as disclosure rows (click or Enter on the summary) and the body is shown whole

module:ui/issues.rs.note: the Local, Dispatched and Sync tabs (G2)

section:issues-workspace-space-i-or-issu.note: Local tab: bounded pages with j/k/gg/G, / and f filters, saved views Ready/Blocked/Mine/Recent, O operator filter, s sort, inspector with Blocked by, Blocks, Events and Handoffs (Tab, PageDown loads more, PageUp backs up), n/e/S/p/a/l/b/dd/A/U writes with the TUI retry rules (stale reload or rebase, also Ctrl-L / Ctrl-R in the form, identical retry key), yy and y# copy, the dependency form taking a number or words to search a bounded candidate page, T starting issue-implement-review-land on the Issue (slice 11's topology run), and the associated sessions (issue_tracker_id) in the inspector, Enter there opening the selected one. G2 adds the Dispatched tab (ListDispatchedIssues: j/k by session and tracker id, Enter inspects, Enter again opens or recovers the session) and the Sync tab (GetIssueTrackerStatus, P runs TriggerIssueTrackerPoll and shows every error, then Sync and Dispatched refresh), switched with [ / ] or the tab bar; r refreshes the active tab
